formally_claimable: MegatrainCGC CUDA training backend codegen is landed and formally gate-passed.
MLXTuneCGC Apple Silicon Metal LoRA/QLoRA backend is landed and formally gate-passed.
torch.compile full graph capture (Megatrain + MLX-Tune) is landed and formally gate-passed.
MegatrainVLLMBridge train->inference weight consistency (tolerance < 1e-5) is formally gate-passed.
TrueOrthoKDA ortho_basis preservation across train->inference is formally gate-passed.
CGC SIMD shared train/inference instruction set is formally gate-passed.
MegatrainHook single-layer streaming execution is formally gate-passed.
MLX-Tune LoRA edge-cloud collaboration loop (Dimension D) is closed and formally gate-passed.
Train-inference unification governance extension is defined and formally gate-passed.
Distributed topology adaptation, ColossalAI hardcode removal, NeMo thin adapter, and the shared C++ MoE engine are formally gate-passed.
Preference alignment trainers (DPO / ORPO / GRPO / KTO / SimPO) are landed and formally gate-passed.
Slime OPD / RL / MoE distillation / speculative decoding / RSWA / teacher-student backend capabilities are landed and formally gate-passed.
All 27 capabilities validated as done; Gate 3.0 and self-harness both passed and were synced to host1 (39.106.118.206) and host2 (47.95.250.55).
not_yet_formally_claimable: Long-term stability of train-inference unification under large-scale training (1000+ GPUs) not yet validated.
MLX-Tune LoRA compatibility across the full Apple Silicon product line (including low-end devices) not yet validated.
Cumulative error of train-inference weight consistency under multi-level quantization chain (fp16 -> int8 -> 2bit) not yet closed.

acceptance_dimensions.A_train_inference_weight_consistency: MegatrainVLLMBridge train->inference weight lossless conversion and consistency (tolerance < 1e-5).
acceptance_dimensions.B_kda_orthobasis_preservation: TrueOrthoKDA ortho_basis preservation and recoverability across train->inference.
acceptance_dimensions.C_cgc_simd_instruction_set_sharing: Shared CGC SIMD instruction set, distributed topology, preference alignment, and Slime training/runtime capabilities consumed by both train and inference sides.
acceptance_dimensions.D_mlx_tune_lora_edge_cloud_collaboration: Apple Silicon edge LoRA/QLoRA -> cloud inference edge-cloud unified loop.

validation_snapshot.summary: All 27 capabilities validated as done. Gate 3.0 formal verify passed, self-harness passed 27/27, and this summary is synced to host1 and host2.
